inputs.text: Open your eyes, people. Five months after the official script tried to sell us a "ceasefire" in Gaza, the ongoing airstrikes and engineered humanitarian collapse are exposing the real agenda of the hidden elites pulling the strings. This is not accidental chaos; it is a calculated, systematic erasure. They want every thread of the population's prewar existence severed to completely reset the contours of life into something darker and far more brutal. Listen to what is actually happening behind their deceitful narratives. As 56-year-old Ahmed Baroud, a father of five currently displaced in Deir al-Balah, exposed, “Drones never stop buzzing overhead, gunfire and shelling continue almost daily and naval boats fire towards fishermen.” The constant surveillance and relentless attacks are fully coordinated instruments of psychological and physical subjugation, designed to strip the people from their past while the mainstream institutions look the other way.
